name: Cascadia Iron — Machine Combat Workshop
description: The oldest continuously operating automaton workshop in GLMZ, Cascadia Iron was founded in 2183 by a collective of displaced engineers following the Lachine Corridor industrial collapse. They compete in the MACHINE WARS series and the WRECK PROTOCOL demolition tournament, fielding heavy-class machines — their flagship 'Thunderhead' line weighing in at 2,400 kilograms — built from salvaged industrial components rather than purpose-manufactured parts.
story_hooks: Cascadia Iron discovers that one of their salvage suppliers has been embedding surveillance hardware in components — and the machines they've already fielded may be transmitting data to an unknown party.
A WRECK PROTOCOL championship machine is stolen from the workshop's secure yard the night before the tournament final.
The founding engineers' original collective charter contains a clause that gives the Lachine Corridor refugee community a governance vote in the workshop — and someone just invoked it.
